column1: # Content: single amino-acid substitutions with a confident ClinVar label (P/LP or B/LB), for calibration and sanity checks
# BRCA1 missense variant dataset - frozen ClinVar extract for the student project
# Pulled: 2026-10-05  (FROZEN - do not refresh during the project; the point is to compare
#   predictions made now against reclassifications that appear later)
# Source: ClinVar, NCBI. Web search API: www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/clinvar/data/search/
# Reference transcript: NM_007294.4 (BRCA1); protein NP_009225.1, 1863 aa
# Genome build: GRCh38, chromosome 17, 1-based positions in grch38_pos
#   ref/alt are plus-strand alleles. BRCA1 is on the minus strand, so they are the
#   complement of the bases in hgvs_c.
#   47 of the single_aa_substitution rows are multi-nucleotide variants: hgvs_c is a delins
#   or an inv and ref/alt are 2-5 bases long. They change a single amino acid, but tools
#   that take one-base VCF records need care with them (filter on len(ref) > 1 to find them).
# Rows are sorted by amino-acid position, then by variant amino acid.
#   aa_ref aa_pos aa_alt    1-letter reference aa, residue number, 1-letter variant aa
#   chr grch38_pos ref alt  GRCh38 coordinates and plus-strand alleles
#   review_stars            0-4, the star equivalent of review_status
#   last_evaluated          date of the aggregate classification (empty if none)
#   n_submissions           number of supporting SCV submissions
#   dbsnp_id                rs identifier where ClinVar lists one
#   variant_class           what the change does to NM_007294.4 (see below)
#   project_set             role in the project (see below)
# variant_class - the ClinVar query matches 'missense variant' on ANY BRCA1 transcript,
#   so some hits are not single amino-acid substitutions in NM_007294.4:
#                                        -> these are the variants to predict
#   reference_pathogenic                 Pathogenic, Likely pathogenic, Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic
#   reference_benign                     Benign, Likely benign, Benign/Likely benign
#   unclassified_excluded                no germline classification, or 'not provided'
